prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Developers needed to build an intuitive Freelance Marketplace
DotNXT Gig Platform is a new project that aims to provide a marketplace for businesses and freelancers to connect and collaborate on various projects. The platform will be similar to Upwork and will offer a range of features that will enable businesses to find and hire skilled freelancers for their projects, needs to be built from scratch possibly using an open source or using ReactJS and NestJS as its programming stack and PostGreSql as the backend with Redis as the caching layer.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications, and I’d be excited to help bring DotNXT Gig Platform to life from the ground up.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’m comfortable working across the full stack and focusing on clean architecture, intuitive user experience, and maintainable code. Building a freelance marketplace requires careful planning around user roles, project workflows, search and discovery, messaging, payments, and scalability, and I understand the importance of getting those fundamentals right early.

Since you’re considering ReactJS and NestJS with PostgreSQL and Redis, I’d approach the platform with a scalable structure that keeps the product modular and easy to extend. I’d pay close attention to the core marketplace features that matter most: onboarding for businesses and freelancers, profile management, job posting, proposal workflows, secure payment handling, and an interface that feels simple and trustworthy. I also value performance and user experience, so I’d make sure the UI stays fast, responsive, and easy to navigate.

I’m especially interested in projects like this because they require both technical execution and product thinking. A marketplace needs more than just working screens — it needs a clear system that supports growth, reliability, and a smooth experience for both sides of the platform. I’d bring a practical, collaborative approach and focus on building the foundation carefully so the product can scale over time.

If needed, I can also help think through the best way to structure the application, organize API endpoints, and keep the frontend and backend cleanly separated while still moving quickly. I’m confident I can contribute to the build in a way that keeps the project moving forward with quality.

What is the highest-priority feature you want to launch first: freelancer profiles, job posting and proposals, or payments and escrow?
